priorityList: Use Vampiric Blood whenever available to maintain high uptime.
Cast Dancing Rune Weapon if Exterminate, Reaper's Mark, and Dancing Rune Weapon buffs are not currently active.
Cast Death Strike if the Coagulopathy buff is about to expire.
Cast Death Strike if Runic Power is near capping (deficit less than 20, or 26 during Dancing Rune Weapon).
Cast Death and Decay if you are not currently standing in its effect.
Cast Marrowrend whenever the Exterminate buff is active.
Cast Death's Caress or Marrowrend if Bone Shield is missing, expiring in less than 3 seconds, or has fewer than 6 stacks.
Cast Death Strike as your primary Runic Power spender.
Cast Blood Boil for AoE damage and disease maintenance.
Cast Consumption (Empowered) while Dancing Rune Weapon is not active.
Cast Heart Strike as your primary Rune spender for cleave and resource generation.
Use Arcane Torrent if you have a significant Runic Power deficit.
Use offensive trinkets and racials (like Blood Fury or Berserking) when Dancing Rune Weapon is on cooldown or near expiration.
